title: reservation-slack-hedger-and-warmlet-prebake-provisioner
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: We observed repeated narrow-window capacity cliffs when fleet decommits (especially spot preemptions and aggressive autoscaler decommits) coincide with tenant bursts. Existing warm-pool logic reacts too late and the Dedicated scheduler can experience transient throughput loss and higher tail latency. This PR introduces two complementary components: (1) a reservation slack hedger that tracks per-pool and per-tenant decommit risk and computes a small proactive buffer (slack hedge) to keep a minimal prebaked warmlet pool; (2) a warmlet pre-bake provisioner that pre-provisions short-lived, pre-bound warmlets that are non-billable until attached, and which are safe to preempt when actual demand materializes.

Summary of changes: adds a hedger controller that computes an EWMA-based decommit-rate and a zone-aware slack ratio; integrates hedger signals into the provisioning planner; implements warmlet pre-bake lifecycle and a minimal runtime integration so runtime will attach warmlets with KV cache warmup hints. Exposes telemetry: slack_hedge_ratio, warmlet_prebake_count, warmlet_prebake_reap_rate, decommit_ewma_1m. Adds unit + integration tests and a migration note for dedicated capacity configs.

Checklist:
- [x] Design doc linked (Linear ENG-3120)
- [x] Unit tests for hedger logic
- [x] Integration test simulating spot preemptions and tenant bursts
- [x] Telemetry dashboards updated (Grafana/telemetry config)
- [x] Migration: default slack_hedge_ratio set to 0.02 (2%) for existing pools

Commits: ["hedger: initial EWMA decommit estimator and config (ae4f3c)", "planner: consume hedger signal and reserve buffer slots (b1c2d7)", "warmlet: pre-bake lifecycle and GC safety (d9e1a5)", "telemetry: expose hedger and pre-bake metrics (f3b2c1)", "tests: integration scenario for preempt+burst (c7a9b0)"]

Files changed (high level): ["pkg/autoscaler/hedger.go", "pkg/provision/warmlet_prebake.go", "pkg/planner/reservation_planner.go", "telemetry/metrics_registry.go", "integrations/tests/prebake_decommit_scenario.yaml", "docs/dedicated/migrations/slack-hedger.md", "pkg/autoscaler/hedger_test.go"]

Small representative snippet (from hedger.go): "func computeSlack(decommitEWMA float64, targetSLO float64) float64 {\n    base := math.Min(0.05, decommitEWMA*1.2) // conservative cap at 5%\n    return math.Max(0.0, base - (targetSLO * 0.1))\n}\n" — the implementation is in the repo; snippet above is illustrative.

Testing and CI: initial CI run failed integration due to timing flake in prebake GC; fixed by adding jitter and stronger timeouts. Final pipeline: build: pass, unit tests: pass, integration: pass, lint: pass. Deployment plan: gradual rollout behind feature flag (provisioner.enabled=false by default). We will enable on a small dedicated pool subset in canary, watch slack_hedge_ratio and warmlet_prebake_reap_rate for GC pressure.

Rollout and safety: hedger computes conservative default slack (2%) and will never allocate beyond a configurable hard cap per-pool. Prebaked warmlets are preemptible and tracked separately from regular reservations to avoid billing surprises. If the hedger detects sustained low utilization, it scales prebakes to zero automatically.
release_notes: Introduce reservation slack hedger and optional warmlet pre-bake provisioner. Default hedger slack set to 2% per-pool. Feature gated; enable via provisioner.enabled and hedger.* configs. Improves resilience to sudden decommits and reduces transient throughput loss.
review_conversation: Arjun Patel (reviewer): Nice approach. Question: what unit is decommitEWMA in? seconds? fraction? Please clarify and add bounds checking so it can't produce NaN.

Maya Chen (author): decommitEWMA is a fraction (decommits per slot per minute normalized). Updated comments and added NaN guard in computeSlack; added unit tests that exercise zero and extremely high decommit rates.
Sofia Rivera (reviewer): Integration test was flaky; observed prebake GC race where a warmlet was double-reaped when a preempt and GC coincided. Can we add a CAS guard or move to optimistic locking?
Maya Chen (author): Switched GC to use staged state transitions with CAS and added random backoff jitter. Integration test updated to surface race deterministically; CI green now.
Ben Liu (reviewer): Telemetry looks good. Can we add an alert when warmlet_prebake_reap_rate > 0.1 for more than 5m? Suggested query included in docs.
Maya Chen (author): Added Grafana alert in docs/migrations and wiring to existing alerting team.
change_summary: New hedger controller (pkg/autoscaler/hedger.go) computes per-pool decommit EWMA and outputs slack_hedge_ratio
Reservation planner consumes slack signal and reserves buffer slots in reservation_planner.go
Warmlet prebake lifecycle implemented (pkg/provision/warmlet_prebake.go) with safe GC and preemption semantics
Telemetry metrics and dashboards added (telemetry/metrics_registry.go, docs)
Integration tests simulating spot preemptions and sustained bursts added
notes: Feature rolled out behind feature flag. Default behavior for existing customers is unchanged. Ops runbook added to docs/dedicated/runbooks/prebake-hedger.md explaining knobs, observed metrics, and rollback steps.
